0x00083C.en: 「With what I've got now...@　this is as far as I go...!」

0x0008AD.en: 「Guh! @　So this is where it ends...!!」

0x000935.en: 「Damn it! @　You won't get me next time!」

0x000A5E.en: 「Is this as far as I go......!?」

0x000A96.en: 「Oh dear...@　how uncool of me, honestly!」

0x000B5F.en: 「Ngh! So this is as far as I go...!」

0x000B9A.en: 「Screwing up in a place like this...!@　This isn't funny...」

0x000BEE.en: 「Blew it...!@　Nothing to do but bail...」

0x000CD8.en: 「This is as far as I go......!」

0x000D3F.en: 「This is the end... the rest is up to you.」

0x000D71.en: 「Damn it...!@　Is this as far as I go!」

0x000DEB.en: 「No good, took too much damage...... Retreating!」

0x000E38.en: 「Well, I'm done for. I'll leave the rest to you.」

0x000E76.en: 「Aaah, I leave the rest to you!」

0x000EBD.en: 「To think the Granzon... would be shot down...」

0x000F68.en: 「Ngh...... So I'm the one falling like a meteor...... Ejecting!」

0x000FE7.en: 「I-I can't take any more of this......!」

0x00101F.en: 「Owowow...... I give up, that was a miscalculation.」

0x0010A4.en: 「U...ngh! So this is as far as I go...!」

0x001158.en: 「I'm sorry. The rest is up to you.」

0x00118D.en: 「Damn it! Is this as far as my strength goes...!」

0x001279.en: 「To go down in a place like this...@ I'm still too green...!」

0x0012C7.en: 「No good, I can't take any more! Falling back!」

0x001340.en: 「Sorry!@ I'm gonna have to pull out...!」

0x0013B1.en: 「N-no good! This is as far as I go!!」

0x0013EF.en: 「Well, well... so this is the end.」

0x00141E.en: 「I can't go on. I'll take my leave.」

0x0014A9.en: 「Careless of me...@ I'll pull back for now...!」

0x001526.en: 「Tch...! I can't hold out after all...!」

0x00160F.en: 「Retreating...@ Ngh...! So much for looking cool...」

0x0016CD.en: 「Guaah! Not in a place like this!!」

0x00197A.en: (At this rate...@ If we stay on the defensive, we'll get nowhere.)

0x0019D0.en: (To see through Mitarl's true intent...@ to uncover the truth of the Zentl Project...)

0x001A4B.en: 「...What's wrong, Hugo?@ You look more troubled than usual.」

0x001ABD.en: 「That answer again?@ If something's bothering you, talk to me.@ We're partners, after all.」

0x001B3E.en: 「...Just focus on operating@ the TE Absorber. That's all you need to do.」

0x001BB5.en: (Haah... at this rate, being a duo like Lieutenant Kyosuke@ and Ensign Excellen might be@ completely out of reach...)

0x001C6A.en: 「A girl about ten years old? Hmm...」

0x001D06.en: 「Thing is, we don't have any guests@ traveling with a child...」

0x001D59.en: 「Um... Irui's clothes showed signs@ of having been soaked, then dried...」

0x001DC4.en: 「So she was shipwrecked at sea@ and washed up on Comodin Island?」

0x001E17.en: 「There was a storm the day before the Hiryu Kai arrived.@ We can't rule out the possibility.@ Same thing happened to Touma.」

0x001ED3.en: 「Yeah. I was on a tuna boat and got shipwrecked...」

0x001F19.en: 「Anyway, wouldn't it be better to ask this@ Irui girl about it directly?」

0x001F87.en: 「That's the thing... she seems to have lost her memory.@ She doesn't remember anything before the island...」

0x002026.en: 「Yeah, and nothing to identify her, either.@ So... when you leave the ship, Ruslan,@ I want you to take her with you.」

0x0020D4.en: 「And if you could look into where her family is, too...」

0x00211D.en: 「If it's a favor from you, Carla, I can't refuse.@ All right, I'll figure something out.」

0x002189.en: 「I'm sorry...@ for not being able to remember what matters...」

0x00220A.en: 「And there's no need to rush.@ Some little thing might bring your memory back in time.」

0x002278.en: 「Besides, you'll be fine on this ship.@ Everyone here will protect you. So don't worry.」

0x00231E.en: 「It's almost time for the briefing.@ Let's go.」

0x00236B.en: 「See you later, Irui. I'll come by again.」

0x0023DC.en: 「According to new intel from Lt. Gen. Jacob@ Moore, Antarctica itself is covered by a@ Dimensional Rift, blocking attack or entry...」

0x002484.en: 「Currently, the Federation and Gaia Sabers are@ fighting the Ruina, centered on@ Patagonia in South America.」

0x00251D.en: 「What's more, multiple enemy mobile weapon groups@ have appeared around the Queen Elizabeth Islands@ in the Arctic, barring human entry.」

0x002606.en: 「Before I answer that,@ let me first cover our latest theories@ on the crisis we're facing.」

0x00269C.en: 「Put simply, the Rift cuts out space around Earth@ and drops it whole into another dimension,@ severing Earth from its original one.」

0x00275F.en: 「To put it more plainly...@ picture Earth drawn on a sheet of paper. Cut around it,@ leaving one part joined, then fold that flap under.」

0x00280A.en: 「Now Earth can't see the paper's surface,@ and vice versa. From space, that is,@ from the paper's surface, Earth would seem gone.」

0x0028D9.en: 「I sort of get it, and sort of don't...」

0x00294E.en: 「This is purely conceptual, but...@ wouldn't the hole left after cutting Earth out be visible?」

0x0029C5.en: 「That's possible.@ It's also conceivable the Ruina are@ sealing it off by some means.」

0x002A4F.en: 「Either way, we can't get outside Earth@ as things stand, so there's no point@ picking that apart right now.」

0x002B13.en: 「Hold on, that paper analogy from before...@ if one part stays connected, that means...」

0x002B78.en: 「Earth wasn't completely severed@ into the other dimension...?」

0x002BDA.en: 「Weighing all the evidence, that's the inference.」

0x002C1A.en: 「Also, if the Ruina mean to destroy all humanity,@ those in space could become targets too.」

0x002C9A.en: 「Meaning they may have secured a means of reaching space...@ a way to break through the Dimensional Rift.」

0x002D1A.en: 「And you're saying that exists at the poles?」

0x002D60.en: 「Yeah. There's also a theory the Rift around Earth@ is kept up by some kind of generator@ built at the South and North Poles.」

0x002E20.en: 「So if we smash one of them,@ the Dimensional Rift might vanish?」

0x002E88.en: 「...I doubt it's that simple.@ We may have to destroy both of them.」

0x002F0E.en: 「Could the Arctic end up covered@ by a Rift like Antarctica?」

0x002F6A.en: 「It's possible, but no reports of the same@ phenomenon in the Arctic have come in yet.」

0x00302D.en: 「Yes. A joint operation with the Gaia Sabers@ to push into the Arctic Ocean is underway.」

0x00309B.en: 「And this has already been announced to the public,@ as the means to restore Earth.」

0x003115.en: 「There's no solid proof, though.@ Isn't this too hasty?」

0x00316E.en: 「Without it, the public panic can't be contained.@ Martial law has reportedly been declared@ in several cities.」

0x00320D.en: 「So if it has no effect at all...」

0x00324A.en: 「The chaos will spread even further than now.」

0x00328D.en: (Because of my father, things keep getting worse...)

0x0032D6.en: (If the key to the Rift's riddle lies in the Arctic,@ then I...)

0x003349.en: 「Captain, a Federation PT unit and the Ruina@ are in combat along our course.@ What are your orders?」

0x0033E0.en: 「Our allies are outmatched... they may be wiped out.」

0x003426.en: 「Then we head to their aid at once.@ All hands, battle stations, level one!」

0x0034F7.en: 「Heh, reminds me of the L5 Campaign.@ Back then the Bugs swarmed out@ like flies on cheese.」

0x0035A6.en: 「Don't worry, rookie.@ Our unit's got a goddess of fortune on our side.@ You'll make it home alive, too.」

0x003671.en: 「This is Colonel Lefina Enfield, commander of@ the Steel Dragon Squadron. We'll take these@ enemies. Fall back and defend the city.」

0x003737.en: 「I'm Lieutenant Daniel Howell, leader of the 112th@ PT Platoon aboard the Almirante. I'll have no choice@ but to report this to my superiors.」

0x0037EB.en: 「Understood.@ It gives you a reason to withdraw, doesn't it?」

0x003847.en: 「...Roger.@ Abeja 1 to Abeja 2, 3.@ We're falling back.」

0x0038CC.en: 「They'll fight easier without us in the way.@ All units, move out.」

0x003938.en: 「...Sir, so that's what you meant by a goddess of fortune?」

0x003981.en: 「Our unit's got luck on its side.@ But this is my first time seeing the real thing, too.」

0x0039EF.en: 「...Abeja 1 to Dragon 2.@ Good luck to you.」

0x003A3F.en: 「Seems not all of the Federation@ regards us as the enemy.」

0x003AEC.en: 「We'll hold the Ruina back here!@ Don't let them get behind our current position!」

0x003B66.en: 「Ruina...@ I won't let you bring about the ruin you speak of!」

0x003BBC.en: 「Captain, an enemy has crossed the defense line.」

0x003BF9.en: 「We can't let it slip out of the combat zone!@ Take it down, quickly!」

0x003C4F.en: 「A new Ruina unit, approaching the coastline!」

0x003CB1.en: 「Judging by the pattern so far,@ it may be piloted by a Melior Esse.」

0x003D1F.en: 「I'll ask it myself!@ Hey, you there! What's your name!?」

0x003D7B.en: 「I am Glacies of the Melior Esse, the ice.@　Humans... perish in your terror.」

0x003DEC.en: （Glacies...@　Could she be the 'Raki' that@　Ignis spoke of?）

0x003F6F.en: 「Ngh, what is this... that thing...@　that enemy!?」

0x004049.en: 「Could it be that only Joshie@　can hear something...!?」

0x0040E2.en: （What's happening...?@　Joshua... Radcliff...?@　What is this?）

0x004151.en: （That human's consciousness...@　is it syncing with me!?）

0x0041E7.en: （Y-You are... that consciousness of yours...!@　G-Guuh...!!）

0x0042C4.en: 「Gh, damn it... what just happened...?@　Sympathia's... overloading...」

0x0043F3.en: 「If you mean, like,@ static ran through the system and let a voice through,@ same as with Aquila and Ignis...」

0x0044CB.en: (Our minds linked... just hers and mine...@ but inside her, there was...!)

0x004536.en: 「Gh, uugh...@　That thing... I recognize it as@　something to be purged, immediately.」

0x004595.en: 「Josh, do you have@　some kind of connection@　to that Melior Esse?」

0x004648.en: 「Whatever that thing is...@　I'll find out for myself, directly...!」

0x00470C.en: 「Understood.@　We want intel on the Ruina too.@　You try to make contact with Glacies.」

0x0047F6.en: 「Stuff like this leaves a bad taste, huh.@　Gotta clear it up!」

0x0048B7.en: 「Joshua Radcliff...@　if I destroy you, will this malfunction cease?」

0x00493B.en: 「A reaction like with Aquila and Ignis...@　but this girl isn't as affected as Bro's machine...」

0x004A3E.en: 「What are you... what are you really?@　Why does that heart of yours seek to slaughter humans?」

0x004AB2.en: 「We are what we are.@　We were born into this world for that purpose.」

0x004B33.en: 「The death and ruin of all things, despair and terror...@　every negative emotion, those very waves are@　what the 'King of Ruin' desires...」

0x004BDB.en: 「You seek life, we seek death.@　Ruina and humans can never coexist.」

0x004C4F.en: 「Then what was that just now!?@　You and I... we-!」

0x004C9C.en: 「This conversation is over.@　You impair my function. So I purge you.」

0x004CF2.en: 「Wait! Why are you different from the other Melior Esse...」

0x004D3B.en: 「You're in my way...!@　Die in agony, you too!」

0x004DDC.en: （...That will, that power...@　Turned to the negative, it would be quite the fuel...）

0x004E44.en: （Those who touch us, their systems@　may harm the northern barrier,@　the Septempulum...!）
